name: Soyuz MS-01
about: Soyuz MS-01 (2016-044A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2016 Jul  7. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2016 Jul  8), held fixed
docked to A07725; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q15971488), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
